probes.name: cache-refresh
probes.source:
Function CellState(p As PivotTable) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=p.DataBodyRange.Cells(1,1).Value2
CellState=p.Name & ":cache=" & p.CacheIndex & ",range=" & p.TableRange1.Address & ",value=" & CStr(v) & ",vt=" & VarType(v)
Exit Function
Failed:
CellState="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function State(c As PivotCache,u As PivotCache,p As PivotTable,q As PivotTable,z As PivotTable) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
State="cache=" & c.Index & ",records=" & c.RecordCount & ",enabled=" & c.EnableRefresh & ";other=" & u.Index & ",records=" & u.RecordCount & ";" & CellState(p) & ";" & CellState(q) & ";" & CellState(z)
Exit Function
Failed:
State="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Act(c As PivotCache,p As PivotTable) As String
Dim b As Boolean
On Error GoTo Failed
c.Refresh
Act="completed"
Exit Function
Failed:
Act="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Disable(c As PivotCache) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
c.EnableRefresh=False
Disable="ok:" & c.EnableRefresh
Exit Function
Failed:
Disable="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,c As PivotCache,u As PivotCache,p As PivotTable,q As PivotTable,z As PivotTable,f As PivotField,s As String,stage As String
On Error GoTo Failed
stage="setup"
Set ws=ActiveSheet
ws.Name="Data"
ws.Range("A1:B1").Value=Array("Region","Amount")
ws.Range("A2:B2").Value=Array("East",10)
ws.Range("A3:B3").Value=Array("West",20)
ws.Range("A4:B4").Value=Array("East",30)
ws.Range("J1:K1").Value=Array("Other","Amount")
ws.Range("J2:K2").Value=Array("X",7)
ws.Range("J3:K3").Value=Array("Y",8)
Set c=ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase,ws.Range("A1:B4"))
Set p=c.CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("D3"),"First")
Set f=p.AddDataField(p.PivotFields("Amount"),"Total",xlSum)
Set q=c.CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("G3"),"Shared")
Set f=q.AddDataField(q.PivotFields("Amount"),"Mean",xlAverage)
Set u=ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase,ws.Range("J1:K3"))
Set z=u.CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("M3"),"Unrelated")
Set f=z.AddDataField(z.PivotFields("Amount"),"OtherTotal",xlSum)
s="version=" & Application.Version & "|" & Application.Build & ";initial=[" & State(c,u,p,q,z) & "]"
stage="edit"
ws.Range("B2").Value2=100
ws.Range("B4").Value2=300
ws.Range("K2").Value2=70
s=s & ";edited=[" & State(c,u,p,q,z) & "]"

stage="first-action"
s=s & ";first=" & Act(c,p) & ";after-first=[" & State(c,u,p,q,z) & "]"
stage="repeat-action"
s=s & ";repeat=" & Act(c,p) & ";after-repeat=[" & State(c,u,p,q,z) & "]"
Probe=s
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe=s & ";PROBE-ERROR:" & stage & ":" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
